summary: Cloudflare OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE sign-in that yields an Axo web session cookie.

steps.action: create state and PKCE verifier in a sealed __Host-axo_oauth cookie (10 min)
on callback: verify state, exchange code, fetch userinfo
map (issuer, subject) to an immutable Axo account ID
store session digest, expiry and profile (transaction)
set __Host-axo_session cookie (30 days, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax); redirect to /app
